rules.statement: A trust has been created in favor of the respondent, and the claim can be brought under section 6 of the Prescription Ordinance with a ten-year period.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now, as the legal ownership has to be vested in the person who is designated the owner, language, however forcible and full, may be invoked to vest that ownership without affecting the intention to create a trust in favour of another, and this will explain the use of the words 'absolutely forever'. This done, there must be words to indicate a beneficial enjoyment of the whole or part of that property by another. It would appear that the words 'out of the said lands and premises' satisfies this requirement."
